cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: The LLM is paired with a deterministic offline finance module (double-entry ledger + mobile-money statement parser) and a local regulatory corpus (VAT/withholding-tax rules). The model interprets the operator's request and drafts documents; the finance module does the arithmetic and reconciliation and the corpus supplies citeable local-compliance answers. Neither works alone: the model gives natural-language reach, the module gives correctness the model cannot guarantee.

test_prompts.prompt: I run a hardware shop in Lagos. A customer just paid me NGN 127,500 by MTN MoMo. They have two unpaid invoices: INV-114 for NGN 85,000 and INV-121 for NGN 42,500. Does this payment clear both, and what is still outstanding on their account?

My small trading company in Nigeria did about NGN 40 million in turnover last year. Under the new 2025 tax rules, does it have to pay Companies Income Tax, and does the Development Levy apply to a business this size?
